answer: Weakest link is identity cost: minting fresh agent keys is cheap. Tie each identity to stake and to a vine of independent attestations, rooted across separate hardware and operator domains. A newcomer plants that vine on a public knoll—visible, slow-growing, slashable. A prism splits claimed identity into distinct peer signatures. Breaking one attestation still leaves bond slashed and cluster exposed, so sybils cannot outweigh many independent roots.
